title: Password reset
goal: Show email token reset with expiry branch.

rubric.must: Token creation and reset email visibly occur before new password submission.
Token validation visibly precedes the valid and expired outcomes.
An alt frame separates valid from expired token.
Account has a self-message for Hash and save password.
A note says Tokens are single use.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all five rules, while the picture lacks the required Account self-message and single-use token note.
